snippet.title: Spellagories gameplay (Playfirst games nostalgia)
snippet.description:
Spellagories is a word game that combines a medieval fantasy atmosphere with anagram solver mechanics, where you spell words to break the spells cast upon villagers by evil wizards and sorceresses.

You have until the sun sets to find all the words to break a villager's spell. The quicker you guess the magic word during the day, the longer you will have at night. During the night, you spell as many words as you can as the wizard approaches the window. It might take quite a few nights to get the counterspell ready. 

Spellagories was a Playfirst game developed by Mind Control Software, LLC and released on PC in July 2005.
Archived website: https://web.archive.org/web/20080528222710/http://www.playfirst.com/game/spellagories
